+      "NativeIaC": "```yaml
# CloudFormation: Enable deletion protection on an Auto Scaling group
Resources:
  <example_resource_name>:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      DeletionProtection: prevent-all-deletion
      MinSize: "1"
      MaxSize: "3"
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - <subnet_id_1>
        - <subnet_id_2>
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: <launch_template_id>
        Version: $Latest
```",
+      "Other": "1. In the AWS Console, go to EC2 > Auto Scaling Groups and select <example_resource_name>
2. Click Edit
3. Under Details, find Deletion protection
4. Select prevent-all-deletion
5. Click Update to save",
+      "Terraform": "```hcl
# Terraform: Enable deletion protection on an Auto Scaling group
resource "aws_autoscaling_group" "<example_resource_name>" {
  name               = "<example_resource_name>"
  min_size           = 1
  max_size           = 3
  vpc_zone_identifier = ["<subnet_id_1>", "<subnet_id_2>"]
  deletion_protection = "prevent-all-deletion"

  launch_template {
    id      = "<launch_template_id>"
    version = "$Latest"
  }
}
```"
+    },
+    "Recommendation": {
+      "Text": "Enable **deletion protection** on Auto Scaling groups to prevent accidental or unauthorized removal:
- Use `prevent-all-deletion` to block all deletion attempts
- Use `prevent-force-deletion` to block force deletion while allowing normal deletion after scaling to zero
Apply deletion protection to all production Auto Scaling groups as a safeguard against operational errors.",
+      "Url": "https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/resource-deletion-protection.html"
